visualReview.notes: All nine current portable and nine current shared frames inspected, plus full-resolution entrance and beacon. Arched entrance is now a dark recess above its timber door. White taper, six-meter brown base, pedimented lower window, 24 corbels, double galleries and modern ribbed Sabik beacon render connected.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Metric ashlar, limestone belt, lime-plastered shaft, timber entry and painted iron use shared maps. The dark entrance recess no longer inherits blue lantern glazing. Fine rail and beacon details remain legible at close range.
